Before we start

How much will my project cost?+

Every quote starts with your pages, content, integrations, and goals. You receive a fixed scope and project fee before work begins. Pricing: [to be confirmed]. Ongoing support and advertising spend are separate.

How long does a website take?+

Timing is agreed after discovery. Content readiness, integrations, and feedback affect the schedule. Your proposal includes milestones and dependencies.

How do revisions work?+

The proposal defines revision rounds and approval points. Changes beyond the agreed scope are quoted before they are started.

What happens after launch?+

You receive a handover and agreed launch support. Longer-term maintenance, content updates, and SEO can be scoped separately.
